case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No(s). 6261−6262 of 2021)

parties.respondent: Dr. Pradeep Kumar Panigrahi and Others

summary: Scope of preliminary inquiry under Odisha Lokayukta Act; Lokayukta's power to entrust inquiry to external agency (Directorate of Vigilance); natural justice considerations; High Court's interference in preliminary procedural stage; statutory interpretation of Sections 20, 25, 28 of Odisha Lokayukta Act 2014; complaint by Vigilance officer against MLA; administrative bias claims rejected; High Court directive to Lokayukta's inquiry wing improper.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Lokayukta's Order dated 11 December 2020 directing Directorate of Vigilance to conduct preliminary inquiry upheld.
